svg.title: The measured window between a run id and its live pointer
svg.desc: A hand dispatch measured on 2026-09-26 minted its run id at 14:28:11Z and wrote its live pointer at 14:28:29Z. A second dispatch at 14:28:18Z read no pointer, took the identical review-store paths and was accepted; the same empty read made the review reflex miss the first run. At the change the claim is written at the run id, so the second dispatch meets it and is refused naming the first.
svg.text: The window a peer measured on 2026-09-26: eighteen seconds, and a second dispatch inside it
Two hand dispatches of one review record: r-...142811418533 minted first, r-...142818622946 accepted on the identical two review-store paths.
At base — the id exists at 14:28:11; nothing on disk says so until 14:28:29
14:28:11 id minted — no claim written, so no reader sees these paths
14:28:18 second dispatch reads no claim and is accepted
At the change — the claim is written at the run id, before the preflight and the worktree
14:28:11 the claim is written at the run id: a live pointer with no pid and no worktree
14:28:18 second dispatch meets the claim and is refused, naming it
The exclusion falsified — a re-check that does not skip this call's own run id refuses the call itself
its own claim, read back at the pointer write, would be a conflict if this call did not skip its own run id
the assertion for this race fails at base (82 passed, 3 failed) and passes at the change (85 passed)
